title: Superlatively
summary: SUPER'LATIVELY, adverb In a manner expressing the utmost degree. I shall not speak superlatively of them. 1. In the highest or utmost degree. Tiberius was superlatively wicked; Clodius was superlative

inlines.v: SUPER'LATIVELY, adverb In a manner expressing the utmost degree. I shall not speak superlatively of them. 1. In the highest or utmost degree. Tiberius was superlatively wicked; Clodius was superlatively profligate.
